Game Overview

Qube Up is a hyper-casual game built around speed through colorful landscapes as a vibrant yellow cube in Qube Up. Navigate treacherous obstacles with precision, collect shimmering stars, and experience the thrill of ever-increasing speed. This captivating arcade adventure tests your reflexes, offering simple yet addictive escapism that keeps you coming back for higher scores.
